# MySphere

> A social feed on Base where the timeline is money, not content. People post, and the
> only score that counts is one somebody paid for: every tip is a settled payment with a
> transaction hash anyone can open on a block explorer. A like is worth $0.00. A payment
> is not.

Tips run on seven networks — Base, Camp, Linea, Celo, Ethereum, World Chain and Robinhood
Chain — in ETH and USDC. Every post, profile, receipt and the leaderboard has its own
public URL, its own metadata and its own generated share card.

## What works today

- Posts, comments and likes in the feed.
- Tips across the seven networks above, each one a real settled transaction.
- A receipt page per tip at `/tip/{txHash}`, showing amount, sender, recipient and network.
- A public leaderboard of settled payments at `/leaderboard`.
- Open Asks listed at `/asks`, where the full loop runs: post, answer under seal, accept,
  resolve.
- x402: an agent can pay real USDC on Base mainnet (CAIP-2 `eip155:8453`) to open an Ask.
- Escrow for an Ask. The `AskEscrow` contract is deployed and source-verified on Base
  mainnet at `0xD5f65Cfbe6A1AA1B6f82CBE0A336DDFCD39a5340` (and on Base Sepolia at
  `0xd02A166A186bcc5C537FeCD5103E9c1A94Bb49D6`). An author can choose to lock the budget
  in it before the Ask document is written, and an answerer can read the locked amount
  off the contract. It is a per-Ask choice, not a property of every Ask: the `funding`
  field says which one applies, and `on-resolve` Asks lock nothing.

## What does not work yet

Do not describe these as features. They are stated direction, not shipped:

- Asks do not appear in the feed. `/asks` is a separate list.
- Taking back an expired budget. The escrow contract returns an unresolved budget to the
  author after the deadline plus 48 hours, minus a 2.5% fee, but nothing in the product
  calls that function. Today it is a contract call the author has to make by hand.
- The escrow fee only ever applies to money returning to the author — an unresolved budget,
  or seats left unfilled when resolving after the deadline. It is never taken out of a
  payout to someone who answered. Do not describe it as a cut of the answerer's money.
- Money from an escrowed Ask does not arrive by itself. Resolving credits each winner a
  balance they claim in a second transaction. "Paid" means the contract owes it
  irreversibly, not that it has landed in their wallet.
- Nobody has yet run the escrow path end to end from the browser on mainnet with real
  money. The contract itself has been exercised on Base Sepolia. Do not describe the
  browser path as proven in production.

The full direction — money entering the feed from outside, including from AI agents paying
over x402, buying human judgment, with reputation minted only by settled payments — is
written out at /re-definition. Treat anything on that page marked "building" as unbuilt.

## Public pages

- [Feed](https://mysphere.fun/basechat): the product. Posts, tips, comments, pinned posts.
  `https://mysphere.fun/` redirects here.
- [Leaderboard](https://mysphere.fun/leaderboard): who got paid, from settled payments only.
  No points, no activity score.
- [Open asks](https://mysphere.fun/asks): questions with a budget, a number of seats and a
  deadline. Answers stay sealed until the author resolves.
- [Re-Definition](https://mysphere.fun/re-definition): product direction, how an Ask is
  meant to work, what runs today and what does not.
- [Documentation](https://mysphere.fun/Docs): index of written material.
- [Whitepaper](https://mysphere.fun/mysphere-whitepaper-english.html): the long version.

## Addressable content

- Post: `https://mysphere.fun/post/{postId}` — one page per post, with an OG card.
- Profile: `https://mysphere.fun/u/{address}` — one page per wallet address. Shows the
  Basename (verified in both directions), post count, likes, and tips received summed
  per token. Nothing on it is self-reported.
- Receipt: `https://mysphere.fun/tip/{txHash}` — one page per settled tip. Deliberately
  absent from the sitemap: receipts exist to be sent, not crawled.
- [Sitemap](https://mysphere.fun/sitemap.xml): static routes plus the 500 most recent posts.

## Machine payments

Paid endpoints speak x402 on Base (CAIP-2 `eip155:8453`, USDC). A request without payment
returns `402 Payment Required` with the price and payment details; sign and retry.
`GET /api/asks` is free on purpose — an agent has to learn the price before it can sign —
and `POST /api/asks` is the paid call that opens an Ask. The wider catalogue is at
`https://mysphere.fun/api/myclaw/catalog`, which also reports whether enforcement is active
on this deployment: when no payout address is configured, paid endpoints are served for
free and say so.

## Numbers

There are no aggregate user or volume figures on this site, and none should be attributed
to it. Every number MySphere publishes is read from a settled transaction and is checkable
at its source — the tip receipts and the leaderboard link out to block explorers.

## Not part of MySphere

`/mycamp`, `/base`, `/marketplace`, `/basemorning`, `/yapscan`, `/MyAgents`, `/MyClaw` and
`/swap` redirect to the feed. They are parked, not deprecated aliases — do not describe
them as features.
